visibleTestCases.title: Non-Blocking Guest Session Hydration
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, S} = session_ttl_server:start_link(60), Valid = session_ttl_server:is_valid(S, <<"guest">>), session_ttl_server:stop(S), Valid end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Confirms that handle_continue populated default guest session immediately.

visibleTestCases.title: Active Session Count Tracking
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, S} = session_ttl_server:start_link(60), session_ttl_server:create_session(S, <<"user_101">>), Count = session_ttl_server:get_active_count(S), session_ttl_server:stop(S), Count end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies active session tally after registering user_101.
